svg.title: Selected controlled-current source cohort status
svg.desc: Five unchanged retained Xyce VCCS programs. Before the fix all five were blocked. After the fix all five agree with ngspice on LU and Faer. Two also agree on Intel; three were not run there. This is not a whole-corpus count.

g.text: Five original programs: shared blocker removed
Selected RSpice-retained Xyce VCCS cohort · November 14, 2026
All 12 requested DC points and four physical observables checked per program/provider.
One preparation capability, not five new device models. Authored dynamic example counted separately.
Outside the historical 113-file ngspice cohort; no new full-corpus count is claimed.
